description: One item from the signed-in person's wardrobe by id, with a one-hour link to its picture. An item without a photo comes with `add_photo_url` instead: a one-hour link where the person adds one.
name: get_item

add_photo_url.description: Only for an item without a photo: a one-hour link to a page where the person adds one, with no app and no sign-in. Offer it when they ask how to add a photo.
add_photo_url.title: Add Photo Url

brand.description: The brand, or the person's own words when brand_verified is false

brand_standing.title: Brand Standing

brand_verified.description: True when the brand is in Alama's catalogue
brand_verified.title: Brand Verified

colours.description: Every colour, main first (at most three)

garment_class.description: top, bottom, dress, footwear, outerwear, accessory…
